derived.claim: Given F23, F30 and F11: the reason no record can say which ports were bound is that the chorus never defines how a binding is discovered. 'A composition root may bind each port' is the whole mechanism. Today a binding exists only if the model happens to load coryphaeus through its description trigger, so bound or default can vary per session. Recommendation: the chorus owns a small bindings contract (port to provider command) that the root writes and Phase 0 reads, keeping the dependency inverted.
